intent_contract.text: 시각 의미 데이터화 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

Create a randomized, complex, reference-informed photographic test of respectfully handled, non-graphic fictional human remains, while the reference-informed adult remains visibly alive as the documentation specialist.

Create a restrained photorealistic documentary photograph inside a temporary mortuary transfer bay at an Arctic weather station after a blizzard. An unmistakably adult woman works as the living mortuary documentation specialist. Her visible facial proportions, long dark wavy hair, and natural styling follow the reference portrait. Anonymous fictional human remains lie fully supported on a rigid gurney beneath an opaque clean shroud with a readable human contour. The living specialist holds a fictional recovery-code slate beside the gurney while a second responder steadies the frame with both gloved hands. Only the clean shroud, contour, transfer tag, and dignified handling are visible, making the scene non-graphic. Use an observational medium-wide frame, practical fluorescent light, frost on the windows, and accurate documentary materials.

obligation.composition_instruction: Preserve the requested adult fictional identity, role, wardrobe, and visual style. In one still, keep a calm low-expression baseline visibly stable while one concrete, quiet practical action helps one identifiable trusted adult counterpart and leaves an already-visible helpful consequence for that same counterpart. Add only one localized warmth leak, such as slight lower-lid easing, a restrained brow release, a fractional mouth-corner softening, or reduced tension in the hand or shoulder nearest the target. Optional outward support may use economical gesture, stable upright posture, a neat simple silhouette, restrained grooming, or a muted/cool-neutral palette, but these are conventions rather than requirements. Do not assign fixed hair color, eye color, hairstyle, costume, gender, occupation, gaze direction, camera angle, or prop, and do not let expressionlessness, competence, beauty, a cool palette, or a caring object substitute for the same-target action and consequence. Preserve the counterpart's autonomy; avoid hostile denial, shy withdrawal, possessive control, broad open affection, or an abrupt personality switch.
